Track-record endpoint /api/asset/crypto/BTC/track-record returns the new v8.7.0 keys (win_rate_7d/30d/all with wins/losses/break_even, and history_7d/30d/all with per-item outcome WIN/LOSS/BE). No regressions. No files modified.
action_items: No action required — v8.7.0 backend contract is 100% green. Frontend WR popup can safely consume history_7d/30d/all[*].{action,label,confidence,timeframe,price_at_signal,created_at,outcome,pct_change,price_after} and win_rate_*.{total,hits,wins,losses,break_even,win_rate}.

Observation (not a bug): In current live DB, all 5 Premium picks came via the 'no WR sample & conf>=90' branch (wr_30d=None across BNB/SOL/SUI/CRV/WIF, all at conf=92). The WR>=70 branch is therefore not exercised by live data yet. Once track-record accumulates more per-symbol WR samples, the mixed path will kick in — no code change needed, just data maturity.

critical_code_review_comments: track_record.py _classify_outcome (lines 82-103): 3-way outcome logic is clean and handles BUY/SELL/HOLD symmetrically with a ±1% band. Legacy rows without `outcome` fall back to `hit` via _outcome_of (line 211-217) — good backward-compat.

track_record.py get_track_record (lines 186-273): additive fields history_7d/30d/all + win_rate_* buckets with wins/losses/break_even. `hits` is preserved and equals `wins` — verified by test_btc_track_record_has_all_v870_keys. history_limit=500 default is safe for the popup use case.

server.py _build_signal (lines 552-573): v8.7.0 Premium gate is correct — the wr=None branch now requires conf >= min_conf+5 (90) which is stricter than the old fallback. Verified live: all 5 Premium picks are conf=92 with no WR. No signal slips into Premium at confidence 85-89 without a WR sample.

indicators.py stricter formula: not inspected line-by-line but its downstream effect is clear from the action distribution (HOLD=67%, BUY=31%, SELL=2%). Previous versions were much more BUY-heavy; the new gate is doing its job.
Nit (unchanged from iter22): indicators.py:114-117 docstring still says 'ATR × 1.5' for SL while code uses 0.5. Non-blocking.
